name: app-shater-craftsman-app-hero-with-onboarding-screens-below
title: Shater craftsman app hero with a phone in hand, followed by five onboarding and identity-verification screens
whatItIs: A light page with the 'تطبيق الحرفي' hero (phone in hand over a hard-hat photo) above five app screens (order tracking steps, chat, an empty package illustration, service browsing, a splash logo), then a row of four numbered identity-verification steps (Complete Data, Verify Account, Personal Data, Professional Data) with a green checkmark for accepted accounts.
whatItMeans: Trust-building and thorough; a numbered verification flow shows how the platform screens craftsmen before letting them work.
techniques: Use an empty-state illustration for a no-content moment.
Mark the final accepted state in green.

vocabulary.definition: An image shown when there is nothing to display yet.
Confirming a user's real identity before granting access.
